title: LGS after update - closed loop not working
body:
Hi! I've been using AAPS for almost two years with no problem and done two successful updates. This time though I had a lot of problems creating the .apk file with the latest update. I finally managed to create it after two days of constant trying, I even built the app from scratch.

After I installed it, everything seemed fine, even though at first it showed the notification that an update is needed but after restarting AAPS that notification disappeared and never showed up again. Everything worked for about two days (already after 60 days since the update was available) and today morning I suddenly noticed that closed loop is no longer available to me and I've fallen back to the Low Glucose Suspend even though I have the app updated - I can see the new options added and the 'about' info shows version number 3.0.0.1.

Can anyone help me with this problem? I'm so tired fighting with it as nothing I do seems to work. I have uninstalled and reinstalled AAPS few times already and still the same - closed loop for a few minutes and then LGS back again. I thought that might've happened because I imported settings from the previous version but after the last reinstall I didn't do it and it still doesn't work... I've restarted my phone several times and even reconnected my pump again with Ruffy (ACCU-CHEK Spirit Combo) as it also showed another error - that the pump driver changed. 

Please, HELP!

No, I didn't. I didn't think it would change anything. If completing objectives doesn't help, I'll check that.

Thanks for replies, I'll let you know if it helps :)

I finally managed to finish all the questions in objective 3 (took me some time because of having to wait one hour multiple times) but still nothing, all I can have is LGS at most... I will try reinstalling again but any other ideas would be very welcome!
Installed the previous version - close loop seems to work.

I removed all of the previous preferences files and left only the last one from the newest version. Installed the new version. Closed loop worked for a few minutes and now is back to LGS again... I'm running out of ideas.

Can it have something to do with the "Data is coming from different pump. Change pump driver to reset pump state." alarm I'm getting? ACCU-CHEK Spirit Combo with ruffy here.
switching to virtual pump and back should help
